Prisoners Released Ahead of Independence Day in Chhattisgarh

Ahead of India's Independence Day, eight prisoners serving life sentences were released from Ambikapur Central Jail in Chhattisgarh. Another nine prisoners who had completed 15 years of their sentence were released from Raipur Central Jail. Reports described emotional scenes as the prisoners departed, with some seen holding the Bhagavad Gita.
